name: Flux Power
author: Fred Nix
description: Battery as a glowing flux cell whose colour is its charge: blue when full, yellow in the middle, red when low. Sparks ride in while charging, out on battery. Hour-long up/down power trace, live wattage, power profiles.

barWidget.description: A glowing battery cell in the bar that shows power going in or out, with an hour of history and the stock power-profile picker.
